verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਚਕ ਨਿਵਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਣਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaare chak nivaion sikh sa(n)gat aavai aganataa|

en.bdb: He has conquered all the four directions and the Sikh devotees come to him in countless number.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣੀ ਬਣਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: la(n)gar chalai gur sabadh poore pooree banee banataa|

en.bdb: The free kitchen (latigar) wherein the word of the Guru is served runs unabated there and this is the perfect creation(arrangement) of the perfect Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮਪਦ ਮਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh chhatr nira(n)janee pooran braham paramapadh mataa|

en.bdb: Under the canopy of the Lord, the gurmukhs attain the supreme state bestowed by the perfect Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: vedh kateb agocharaa gurmukh sabadh saadh sa(n)g sataa|

en.bdb: In the holy congregation, the. Word Brahm, which is beyond the Vedas and the Ketebas , is attained by gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਜਨਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa vich udhaas kar gur sikh janak asa(n)kh bhagataa|

en.bdb: The Guru has created myriad Janak-like devotees who remain detached amidst maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਬਿਗਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai akath kathaa abigat abigataa|

en.bdb: The mystery of the power of His creation cannot be known and ineffable is the story of that unmanifest (Lord) .
The gurmukhs receive their pleasure fruit without any effort.
